events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, who turns 75.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde's Influence
angles.copy: Seventy-five years young! Chrissie Hynde's fierce style and timeless music with The Pretenders continue to inspire. What's your favourite track from the rock legend?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the legendary Oasis frontman, Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Liam Gallagher, forever the rock 'n' roll star. What's the Oasis anthem that always gets you singing along?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album was released in the UK on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From that legendary zebra crossing to its timeless tracks, what's your standout moment from the album?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's profound album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-five years of 'Imagine'. John Lennon's powerful message of peace and unity resonates as strongly today as it did in 1971. What does this album mean to you?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the 1962 premiere of 'Dr. No', the first film in the iconic spy franchise.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, who's your favourite Bond and which film gets your vote for the best?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the musical genius John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: The iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Marking 25 years since Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod dropped and put '1,000 songs in your pocket'. How did the iPod change your music listening habits?

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrating the 87th birthday of legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Eighty-seven years of brilliance! Happy birthday to the incomparable John Cleese. What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Diversity
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece of diverse sounds. Which track is your unexpected favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential 'Rubber Soul' album in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Evolution
angles.copy: Sixty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'. This album marked a pivotal moment in The Beatles' artistic evolution. What's your go-to track from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the world lost John Lennon. His legacy as a musician, activist, and visionary continues to resonate. What's the song that best captures his spirit for you?
